research_batches.question: Where can a viewer find verified poker-vlog channels, understandable hand breakdowns, and current free video series?
queries: poker vlog official website YouTube hand review
poker beginner video series official free
research_batches.acceptance: Confirm each creator destination through a creator-controlled page. Inspect a public catalogue or representative transcript. Do not claim videos were watched from a title alone.

research_batches.question: Where can a player find original cardroom schedules, structure sheets, and registration policies?
queries: poker room official tournament schedule structure sheet
poker festival official rules registration policy
research_batches.acceptance: Link directly to operators, retaining event-specific scope. Do not duplicate changing dates or turn this into a travel recommendation.

research_batches.question: Which sources add cash-game, live low-stakes, PLO, and Omaha eight-or-better depth beyond the existing library?
queries: PLO strategy free article wraps redraws author
Omaha eight or better scooping quartering strategy
live cash poker multiway pots rake strategy article
research_batches.acceptance: Prefer signed worked explanations and multiple independent publishers. Distinguish four-card, five-card, and split-pot games.

research_batches.question: Which documented tools help with private post-session review, hand records, equity, and reproducible research?
queries: poker hand history specification official documentation
computer poker benchmark dataset evaluation original paper
research_batches.acceptance: Read original documentation and licensing. Describe the actual game model, access requirements, and whether anything was executed; exclude prohibited live-assistance services.

research_batches.question: Which public communities, historical archives, interviews, and home-game references add useful context?
queries: home poker tournament rules structure guide
poker community hand discussion public forum
research_batches.acceptance: Separate community opinions from authoritative rules. Check changed domains and original ownership; avoid deposit-bonus landing pages.

research_batches.question: Which original sources cover player conduct, accessibility, responsible participation, and jurisdiction-specific consumer information?
queries: poker player consumer information gaming regulator official
research_batches.acceptance: Use current official or established support sources. Identify jurisdiction and date; do not write broad legal or medical conclusions from a link listing.
